verdicts.reason: A fills the taller canvas with larger type, but it moves the can up into a gap of about 200px between the subtitle and the date block. The can ends up floating on its own on the right, cut off from the event details, with dead space to its left, and the date block is pushed down. B keeps the original grouping and reading order (headline, details, tags next to the can, then RSVP), but it is mostly a scaled-down copy. Its headline and fine print are smaller, and there is an empty band of about 120px at the bottom plus a wide gap above RSVP. Both still show the 'missing asset' placeholder box, so neither can ship as is.
